 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Recolor the less frequent input color to the more frequent one; clear the majority color."""
    from collections import Counter

    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    majority = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    minority = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    return [[majority if value == minority else 0 for value in row] for row in grid]
